dataSourceInstructions: Use only the explicitly selected Wells, Dataset Metadata, Data Quality, and Categories tables. Categories contains source-history aggregates whose formation, bit, BHA, and other category counts may include quarantined source runs; disclose that limitation whenever category data is used. Do not claim access to underlying SQL views, raw or curated tables, exact run detail, deep provenance, governance files, or any unselected source.
